why: Nine Dragon's map as its floors seen from above (G252, Jake's pick B): the stack's towers rise far over the playable levels and from straight up their roofs and the bridge blocks hide the square, the stair-street and the street, so the bake clips everything above 153 m (just over the deck at Y0 + 24) and the cut towers drop out; what is left is granite floors in cool greys, the plaza's cinnabar neon picked out, every change of level inked, the Well's drop dark with a blue lip, and the void transparent so the map's own dark frame shows through (as Sky Reach)
